mcqs.question: At the 68th Grammy Awards, who won a first Grammy for Best Audiobook, Narration & Storytelling for “Meditations: The Reflections of His Holiness the Dalai Lama”?
mcqs.explanation: The Dalai Lama won his first Grammy in the Best Audiobook, Narration & Storytelling category for “Meditations: The Reflections of His Holiness the Dalai Lama.” Rufus Wainwright accepted the award, while Steven Spielberg and Kabir Sehgal were associated with other aspects of the event.
